Package index

Pre-processing data.

Functions used for pre process data.

collapse_table()
Collapse table
merge_feature_taxonomy()
Merge feature table and taxonomy
from_phyloseq()
Convert a phyloseq object to MicroBioMeta tables
from_tse()
Convert a (Tree)SummarizedExperiment object to MicroBioMeta tables

Abundance visualizations

Functions used for abundance visualizations.

abundance_bar_plot()
Relative abundance barplot
abundance_heatmap_plot()
Heatmap of relative abundance
abundance_sankey_plot()
Sankey diagram of relative abundances

Alpha diversity

Functions used for alpha diversity index and analyses.

alpha_hill_corr_plot()
Alpha diversity vs sequencing depth
alpha_hill_plot()
Hill numbers alpha diversity plot
alpha_diversity_plot()
Alpha diversity indices plot
alpha_decay_plot()
Alpha diversity along a continuous gradient

Beta diversity

Functions used for beta diversity analyses and visualizations.

beta_ord_plot()
Beta diversity ordination plot
beta_dissimilarity_plot()
Beta diversity boxplot
beta_turnover_plot()
Box plot of pairwise feature turnover (Hill numbers)
beta_partition_ord_plot()
Beta diversity partition ordination
beta_decay_plot()
Distance-decay of community similarity plot
beta_test_table()
PERMANOVA or betadisper results table

Important taxa

Functions used to identify important taxa

aldex_heatmap_plot()
ALDEx2 differential abundance heatmap
aldex_volcano_plot()
ALDEx2 volcano or effect size plot
ancombc_plot()
ANCOMBC2 differential abundance bar/heatmap plot
random_forest_lollipop_plot()
Random forest feature importance plot
ratios_bubble_plot()
Compare taxon abundance ratios between two conditions

Other functions

Functions used for other analyses

cca_rda_biplot()
CCA/RDA biplot
corr_env_abund_plot()
Correlation between environmental variables and taxa
venn_plot()
Venn diagram of taxa shared between sample groups
